response.message: A fort's store keeps only grain
Caravans bring back only from your own settlements, forts and supply points

notifications.title: Supply point at (-1, 2) finished
notifications.body: Armies standing there fill up from its grain; supply routes keep it stocked.

notifications.title: Done: Raise a building
notifications.body: Claim its reward from the quest card.

notifications.title: The Builders' Barrow rises
notifications.body: The first builders sleep in the Builders' Barrow with their mark, the rune that bound the old span to Yav. Their dead still guard it: break through and bring the rune back, or no stone will hold the new span. It is marked on the map at (3, -5).
